# Vendored fixtures

`ossie-schema.json` is `core-spec/ossie-schema.json` from
https://github.com/apache/ossie at commit
`c109cf5b0a06970a97599e8f7c2a72859822a3a4` (2026-09-08), spec version
`0.2.0.dev0`. It is a test fixture, regenerated by copying, never edited: the
conformance test in `../ossie_conformance.rs` serialises a model with this
crate and validates it against this schema, so a spec bump shows up as a
visible diff here and a failing test there.
